prose: In the classroom from the photo, empty in the morning, a caretaker in a plain work shirt walks in along the window side with a cloth, bends to a desk in the front row and wipes its top in slow strokes, moves to the next desk and wipes it, then straightens and looks down the room. End on the wiped desks shining in the window light.
